designer_intent.focus: Create a vocal-driven aggressive phonk arrangement emphasizing sparse verses and strong hooks within a sample-based production approach.

presetor_intent.style: Apply gritty, lo-fi effects and analogue-style saturation on drums and vocal samples to fit phonk style.

sensei_drum.brief: Generate sparse yet punchy drum samples using slicing and one-shot hits with variation across sections to support energy curve.

bass_generator.brief: Create supportive bass layers that complement sparse verses but amplify energy during hooks with sample-based textures.

harmony_generator.brief: Design subtle chord pads from loop-based samples that maintain dark, aggressive mood and fill out the texture bed.

melody_generator.brief: Compose sparse melodic textures supporting vocal hooks, using stretched and granular samples to add atmosphere.

ai_designer.brief: Oversee arrangement to ensure vocal-focused structure with dynamic energy curve and proper use of production tree elements.

presetor.brief: Apply phonk-appropriate effect chains and sample processing presets to enhance aggressive, grainy sound quality.

songgps.brief: Map structural sections and energy profile for arrangement with clear demarcation of verses, hooks, and transitions.

ai_mixmaster.brief: Prepare mix settings to maintain clarity of vocal hooks while blending sample layers and ensuring dynamic contrast.
